Intercepts known analytics, third-party trackers, and telemetry beacons. Essential page and video playback requests are never blocked.

Notice: The blocked count represents requests matched by the filter rules, not verified individual advertisements. Facebook serves many ads and videos from the same infrastructure, which cannot be distinguished without breaking media playback.

Configured with conservative rules targeting known tracking scripts, Facebook Pixel (/tr/), telemetry beacons (/ajax/bz), and third-party ad networks while strictly preserving login, account authentication, and video stream delivery.
Statistics have been reset to zero.
